map.输入光功率 P 与波长 λ，求光子通量。: Enter optical power P and wavelength lambda to obtain the photon flux.

map.给定功率的光子数率。: Photon rate for a given power.
map.功率固定为何波长长通量高？: With fixed power, why does longer wavelength give higher flux?
map.每光子能量随波长增大而减小，故同功率光子数更多。: Energy per photon decreases with increasing wavelength, so more photons for the same power.
map.光强=单位面积功率，乘以面积得总光子数率。: Light intensity = power per unit area; multiply by area to get total photon rate.
map.光子通量（本页代码口径）：N=P×λ÷(h×c)（1/s，P 功率 W、λ 波长: Photon flux (this page's code basis): N = P×λ÷(h×c) (1/s, P power in W, λ wavelength in m, h = 6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s, c = 2.99792458×10⁸ m/s); linked values: single-photon energy = P÷(N||1) (J, the denominator falls back to 1 when N is 0), lgN = log₁₀(max(N,1)). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; at the same power a longer wavelength means more photons but lower energy per photon, and the product of the two always equals P.
